deep_dive.title: Green Energy: test whether the battery-driven guidance raise can work despite the index selloff

lines: The core catalyst is a 73.8% upward revision to ordinary-profit guidance, driven by progress in grid-scale battery projects.
On a day when the index is falling sharply, a small-cap name with a clear numeric catalyst can stand out strongly.
FISCO confirmed the morning surge, and by 10:15 JST the stock was up 25.25%.
The company cited battery project contract progress, deliveries and revenue contribution from operating battery sites, making the causal link easy to understand.
Can it hold around the 1,500-yen area and remain near the top of the gainers list in the afternoon.
Does real dip-buying volume appear, or was the move mostly an opening burst.
A quick fade into the low 1,400-yen area would show that the morning momentum is breaking.
The market treats the battery revenue uplift as a one-off rather than a durable earnings step-up.
As a small-cap stock, the move can be volatile and profit-taking can destabilize it quickly.
If the whole market weakens further, even strong-catalyst names can be hit by cash-raising selling.
